channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: "It's always a huge test going to the Hyde" - Bannigan
item.description: Monaghan boss Gabriel Bannigan says his side are expecting "a huge test" this weekend as they travel to take on Roscommon in the second round of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Watch: Meath star Morris nails sensational two-pointer for TUD in Sigerson Cup
item.description: Meath ace Jordan Morris showcased his kicking capability again last night in the quarter-finals of the Sigerson Cup.

item.title: "It's not an easy job that Ger has"
item.description: Former Westmeath star Dessie Dolan feels that Ger Brennan "has a job on his hands" to bring through Dublin's next batch of players that can deliver success.

item.title: "Both teams badly want to get back up to Division 1"
item.description: Tyrone great Peter Canavan sees tomorrow evening's Allianz Football League Division 2 clash between the Red Hands and Derry at Celtic Park (6pm) as being a "very tasty game".

item.title: Murphy omitted from Limerick's league panel
item.description: Limerick manager John Kiely has revealed his panel for the 2026 Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Waterford to be without Walsh for Limerick clash after red card appeal fails
item.description: Waterford are set to be without Sean Walsh for Sunday's home Allianz Hurling League clash against Limerick after the wing forward was unsuccessful in his appeal against the red card he picked up against Cork last weekend.

item.title: "We know what's in front of us" - McGeeney
item.description: Armagh boss Kieran McGeeney says he anticipates another close battle between his side and Galway this weekend.

item.title: Cleary hoping strong Cork performance can silence Drogheda crowd
item.description: Cork manager John Cleary says he hopes his side "can perform and silence the crowd" this Sunday when they take on Louth in Drogheda.

item.title: GAA on TV: Bumper bank holiday weekend ahead with 10 matches to watch live
item.description: The second round games in the Allianz Football and Hurling Leagues are down for decision this weekend with plenty of action for viewers to watch live.

item.title: "We're always encouraged from home. From my Mum and my Dad"
item.description: It is a sport she has loved from a very young age and with several members of her extended family having done likewise in the past, Rachel Dwyer is embracing life as a Gaelic footballer with Kerry.
